messages.author: b207b6a270f65efc
messages.subject: EM cycles terminated after 500 iterations
parts:
Hi phil

I have a problem in my simulation (EM cycles terminated after 500 iterations) 

Increasing number of cycle by (technical=list(NCYCLES=2000) do not solve the problem. what is your recommendation? any help?

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: EM cycles terminated after 500 iterations
parts:
It sounds like the likelihood surface is too flat, so your model is weakly identified. Adding Bayesian priors can make the surface more peaked, but requires some justification. Otherwise, if you can, use simpler and more stable models, or someone obtain a larger sample size. HTH.

Phil
